h1: A tundish drips only while heating
title: A tundish drips only while heating | G3 Cylinder Help
description: Understand a tundish drips only while heating. Distinguish the symptom, gather useful details and arrange competent cylinder assessment in London.
answer: Discharge during a heating cycle can be associated with expansion provision, but the correct cause depends on the installed model and controls.

sections.heading: What this symptom can mean
paragraphs: Some Megaflo models use an internal air volume; many other cylinders use an external vessel. Loss of intended expansion provision is one possible explanation. A relief or inlet-control fault can also need investigation.

sections.heading: Information to gather safely
paragraphs: Note the timing, last service and exact cylinder label. Do not assume all cylinders can be fixed with a domestic Megaflo air-gap routine.

sections.heading: How the enquiry becomes an investigation
paragraphs: The cylinder make, full model and heating arrangement should be identified first. The same visible symptom can arise from different causes, and a relief device may be protecting the system rather than creating the original problem. Component testing and any repair belong to a person competent for the work.

sections.heading: Discuss the appropriate next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 with the postcode, symptom history and any previous service findings. The enquiry establishes the proposed assessment and availability. Do not use this guide as a substitute for the actual appliance safety instructions or an on-site diagnosis.

faqs.question: Does discharge during heating always prove the expansion vessel has failed?
faqs.answer: No. Expansion provision is one possibility; inlet-pressure and valve conditions also require assessment, and some cylinders use an internal air volume.
